description: Retrieve a list of posts from the esa team. Supports search queries, filtering, sorting, and pagination. Returns post metadata including title, content, tags, categories, author information, and engagement metrics (comments, stars, watches). Optionally includes comments and stargazers with the include parameter. Supports nested inclusion like 'comments,comments.stargazers'. Note: body_md is truncated to 300 characters with body_truncated field indicating if truncation occurred.

include.description: Comma-separated list of additional data to include in response (e.g., 'comments', 'stargazers', 'comments,stargazers', 'comments,comments.stargazers').

order.description: Sort order. 'desc' for descending (default), 'asc' for ascending.

page.description: Page number for pagination. Starts from 1.

per_page.description: Number of posts per page. Range: 1-100, default is 20.

q.description: Search query to filter posts. Supports various search operators and keywords.

sort.description: Field to sort posts by. Options: 'updated' (last updated), 'created' (creation date), 'number' (post number), 'stars' (star count), 'watches' (watch count), 'comments' (comment count), 'best_match' (relevance score).

name: get_posts
